summary: Offline import and bounded classification of Linux privilege-boundary assessment exports.
limitations: The package imports local exports only; it has no live collector, shell execution, or host mutation.
Canary access and cleanup are assertions made by the source, not independently verified outcomes.
Imported identifiers must be synthetic or non-sensitive opaque IDs; do not provide raw credentials or paths.
E06.01 source sections remain unmapped pending the E01.1 source review.

demo.description: Classify synthetic positive, negative, and fixed canary exports entirely offline.
